Element: Shadow. VFX: the Cosmic set in shadow: the pipe mouths, the horn rings, the sound
bars, the bell's clapper and the floating note glow and step through violet, deep violet and
lilac every 2 s (its own palette only); notes drift from the pipes on a trill every 4 s and
fall instead of rise; dark smoke falls at its hooves; a violet orbit and a slow violet ring
under it; a shadow trail; the flourish is a hop and a vanish-and-return
